messages:
Alice K: Quick handoff — I'm off at 18:00 PT. Leaving a short checklist for tonight. Canary for model v3.2 is at 50% and steady (no errors so far). Watch: embedding-prod p95 spiked to ~210ms at 16:40 but settled to ~120ms. If it goes >300ms for 10m, escalate to eng-sre.
Ben R: thx. small question — was the config fix merged? PR link?
Alice K: yes, merged at 17:55 PT: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4321. CI passed. Rolling config to prod will finish ~19:10 UTC. No pod restarts required for this change.
Carla S: heads-up: infra scheduled a rolling restart at 22:00 UTC (low impact, 2/12 serving pods affected). infra-bot posted the maintenance note.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance: rolling restarts starting 22:00 UTC, 5-min drain per pod. Impact: brief connection drain, autoscaler will keep capacity. See https://status.redwood-infra/scheduled
Dave M: I'll take overnight watch 22:00–06:00 PT. Ping me for canary regressions or KV cache evictions. @Carla can you drop the runbook link for cache warmup?
Carla S: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-evictions. Key step: run prefill with `./bin/cache-prefill --targets serving-* --prefill 60k`. Also monitor `cache_miss_rate` on the dashboard.
Emily T: FYI I bumped the embedding p95 alert to 250ms to reduce noise while the rollout finishes. Left a note on the dashboard and linked the alert config.
Ben R: quick CR ping @Alice — can you review my retry tweak PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4335
Alice K: will review before I sign off (ETA 17:58 PT).
infra-bot: Deploy-bot: config-rollout v3.2 started at 18:02 UTC, canary 50%, fallback image available if error rate > 1% for 5m.
Dave M: Taking the pages. I'll update PD schedule if anything changes. If someone else wants to hand over earlier, DM me.
Alice K: Action items summary: Ben — get CR merged; Dave — monitor canary + infra restarts; Carla — confirm restart target pods and post list; Emily — watch alerts and revert threshold if too noisy. :thumbsup:
Carla S: Confirmed, posting pod list in 8m. Will also run a quick prefill after config-rollout completes.
Ben R: CR merged at 18:05 PT, thanks.
Alice K: great — thanks everyone. I'm out, leaving Dave as primary. :wave:
thread_text: Quick sunset handoff: canary stable, watch embedding p95, infra restart at 22:00 UTC, action items assigned.
